definitions.explanation: A dark yellowish-brown or reddish-brown color. A somewhat formal or literary term for brown, often used to describe skin tone, natural materials, and scientific contexts.

examples.japanese: {褐色|かっしょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。

examples.english: In autumn, the leaves turn brown.

examples.japanese: {南国|なんごく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{太陽|たいよう}→太陽：03398_taiyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{浴|あ}びて→浴びる：02844_abiru⟧{褐色|かっしょく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{焼|や}けた→焼ける：01138_yakeru⟧⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: The skin tanned brown from the tropical sun looks healthy.

notes:
USAGE:
{褐色|かっしょく} is a formal, literary word for brown. In everyday conversation, ⟦{茶色|ちゃいろ}→茶色：02915_chairo⟧ is far more common. {褐色|かっしょく} is preferred in descriptive writing, scientific contexts, and when referring to skin tone in a neutral way.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {褐色|かっしょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧ (brown skin)
- {褐色|かっしょく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{焼|や}ける→焼ける：01138_yakeru⟧ (tan to a brown color)
- {褐色|かっしょく}⟦{脂肪|しぼう}→脂肪：03199_shibou⟧ (brown fat — scientific term)
- {褐色|かっしょく}{矮星|わいせい} (brown dwarf — astronomy)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{茶色|ちゃいろ}→茶色：02915_chairo⟧: brown (everyday word)
- ⟦{栗色|くりいろ}→栗色：21884_kuriiro⟧: chestnut brown (warmer, reddish-brown)
